name: Introduction to probability and simple events

questions.q: What is the probability of rolling an even number on a standard 6-sided die?
A bag contains 3 red marbles, 5 blue marbles, and 2 green marbles. What is the probability of drawing a blue marble?
If the probability of an event happening is 0.75, what is the probability of it NOT happening?
What is the probability of spinning a number greater than 4 on a fair spinner numbered 1 to 6?
A standard deck has 52 cards. What is the probability of drawing a heart?
What is the probability of selecting a vowel from the letters of the word 'MATHEMATICS'?
Two fair coins are flipped. What is the probability of getting two heads?
Which of the following numbers CANNOT represent a probability?
What is the probability of getting a number greater than 6 on a standard 6-sided die?
A card is drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that it is a face card (Jack, Queen, King)?
A bag has 4 white, 5 black, and 3 red counters. A counter is drawn at random. What is the probability it is NOT black?
What is the probability of rolling a prime number on a fair 6-sided die?
If you roll a die 60 times, how many times would you theoretically expect to roll a 5?
A letter is chosen at random from the word 'PROBABILITY'. What is the probability that it is the letter 'B'?
What is the probability of drawing a red face card from a standard deck of 52 cards?
A box contains 10 cards numbered 1 to 10. What is the probability of drawing a multiple of 3?
What is the probability of an event that is certain to happen?
A coin is flipped and a die is rolled at the same time. What is the probability of getting a head and an even number?
In a bag of 20 sweets, 8 are strawberry, 7 are lemon, and the rest are lime. What is the probability of drawing a lime sweet?
What is the sum of all possible probabilities in a sample space?
A spinner has 4 equal sections colored red, blue, green, and yellow. It is spun twice. What is the probability of landing on red both times?
A bag contains cards lettered A, B, C, D, E. Two cards are drawn without replacement. What is the probability of drawing A then B?
The probability that it will rain tomorrow is 0.35. What is the probability that it will NOT rain?
A bag has 6 red marbles and 4 blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn with replacement. What is the probability both are red?
If you flip a fair coin 100 times, which outcome is most likely in practice?
A bag contains 5 green and 3 yellow counters. One is taken out and NOT replaced. What is the probability the second is green if the first was green?
What is the probability of drawing an ace or a king from a standard 52-card deck?
A bag contains 2 red, 3 green, and 5 blue discs. What is the probability of not drawing a green disc?
What is the probability of rolling a number less than 5 on a standard 6-sided die?
Two 6-sided dice are rolled. What is the sum that has the highest probability of occurring?
A standard number cube is rolled. What is the probability of rolling a multiple of 2 or 3?
What is the probability of an impossible event?
A box contains 5 red pens, 3 blue pens, and 2 black pens. A pen is chosen at random. What is the probability it is red or black?
Three coins are tossed simultaneously. What is the probability of getting exactly two heads?
A letter is selected at random from the word 'PERCENTAGE'. What is the probability it is an 'E'?
If the odds in favor of an event are 3 to 2, what is the probability of the event occurring?

A bag contains 4 red balls, 3 blue balls, and 3 yellow balls. A ball is drawn, its color recorded, and it is replaced. This is done twice. What is the probability of drawing a red ball then a yellow ball?
What is the probability that a randomly chosen day of the week starts with the letter 'T'?
A jar contains 12 marbles: 4 are blue, 3 are red, and 5 are green. If one marble is drawn, what is the probability it is either blue or green?
A bag contains 5 red, 4 blue, and 3 green marbles. What is the minimum number of marbles you must draw to guarantee getting at least one red marble?
